assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of syncope and near-syncope
The patient has known paroxysmal atrial fibrillation
The symptoms are intermittent in nature
There is a need to correlate clinical events with arrhythmic activity
Mobile cardiac telemetry (CPT 93229) is medically necessary
The service captures rhythm data during daily activities
The appeal addresses denial code PR-204
The claim for mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring (CPT 93229) has been denied
The denial determination is based on reason code PR-204
The service is not covered under the member's current benefit plan
